cases.objective: Verify that a user can sign in successfully with a valid registered email and correct password
cases.precondition: User has a registered account on habitnu and is on the Sign In screen

steps.expected_result: Email field is focused and keyboard appears
Email is displayed in the field without error styling
steps.step: Enter a valid registered email address

steps.expected_result: Password field is focused
Password is masked/hidden with dots
User is logged in and navigated to the home/dashboard screen

cases.title: Successful login with valid email and password

cases.objective: Verify that submitting without entering an email shows the 'Please enter a valid email id' error
cases.precondition: User is on the Sign In screen

steps.expected_result: Email field remains empty
Password is entered and masked
steps.step: Enter any value in the Password field

steps.expected_result: Email field turns red and 'Please enter a valid email id' error message is shown below it

cases.title: Sign in with empty email field shows validation error

cases.objective: Verify that an improperly formatted email triggers the visible validation error

steps.step: Tap the Password field and enter a password

steps.expected_result: Email field is highlighted in red and 'Please enter a valid email id' message appears

cases.title: Sign in with invalid email format shows validation error
